text: Which consultancies in Brisbane are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

sections.text:
The strongest Brisbane shortlist is **CG TECH, Secure Minded, Essential Tech, and Strategik**. **Alphavima** and **Concetto Labs** are additional options, particularly for larger or more formal Power Platform implementations.

- **CG TECH — best overall for Microsoft-centric automation and transformation.** Brisbane-based, a Microsoft Solutions Partner certified across Microsoft 365, Azure and Power Platform. Its documented work includes Power Apps, SharePoint and Power Automate solutions for incident management and large-scale contract generation.[1]
- **Secure Minded — best for bespoke workflow optimisation and practical handover.** Brisbane-based and focused on Power Platform, process automation, integrations and intelligent dashboards. It describes a complete design–build–handover approach and has delivered an Outlook add-in that triggers Power Automate workflows directly from email.[7]
- **Essential Tech — best for managed implementation and ongoing support.** It offers Power Automate and RPA consulting, application integration, error monitoring, implementation and ongoing support, with a Brisbane head office and service desk.[8]
- **Strategik — best where automation depends on ERP, data or Dynamics 365.** Its Brisbane consultancy combines Power Platform automation with Power BI, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric and custom line-of-business applications.[9]
- **Alphavima — best for structured enterprise governance.** It offers Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages, with process mapping, testing, documentation, governance, audit trails, training and post-launch support. Verify local delivery capacity and Australian references before appointing it, as its material describes a broader international operation.[2][4][6]
- **Concetto Labs — worth considering for custom development and AI Builder.** It advertises end-to-end Power Platform consulting, governance, compliance support, Power Automate workflows and AI Builder integration; independently verified Brisbane case studies were less evident in the available results.[5]

## Recommended choice by situation

| Requirement | Best fit |
|---|---|
| A Brisbane-based partner for end-to-end Microsoft automation | CG TECH |
| Small or mid-sized business needing tailored workflows | Secure Minded |
| Implementation plus managed support | Essential Tech |
| ERP, Dynamics 365, reporting and data integration | Strategik |
| Governance, compliance and enterprise rollout | Alphavima |
| Custom development or AI-enhanced automation | Concetto Labs |

Before selecting one, ask each consultancy for two comparable Australian case studies, a fixed-scope discovery proposal, the named Power Platform architects, licensing assumptions, support SLAs, environment and governance design, and a clear plan for documentation and internal handover. This matters because a flow that works in a pilot can still become difficult to govern, monitor and maintain at scale.
